title: Greg will be on fire!
description: Greg Park will do a Firewalk for the charity FareShare South West on Tuesday 27 February 2024 at 8.30pm.
author: Barry Adams
html:
On Tuesday 27 February, our very own Greg Park will be walking barefoot across 20 feet of wood embers burning at 670°, hopefully without pain or injury.

He will do this to raise money for FareShare South West, who tackle food waste and fight hunger.

"I like walking barefoot so it should be fun " says Greg, who likes to support this charity to help others who are less fortunate than himself.

If you are willing and able to support Greg financially, you can make a donation to his JustGiving Page.

Alternatively, you are very welcome to come and watch him walk in fire, against the dramatic backdrop of Bristol Cathedral and with the sounds of a samba band in the background. Spectators can arrive from 7.30 and the actual walk will be at 8.30pm.
